reading.title: A Bright Spot at Mount Michael
reading.summary: With austral winter nearing its end, clouds cleared for a satellite view of volcanic activity in the remote South Atlantic.

news.title: Spain’s PM says no evidence ‘whatsoever’ Morocco behind Ceuta border breach
news.summary: Pedro Sánchez continues to defend Rabat after police report claiming border forces helped 70,000 cross border Europe live – latest updates Spain has seen no evidence “whatsoever” that Morocco planned or facilitated a mass border breach into its north African territory of Ceuta, the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has told parliament. The address on Thursday followed the emergence of a police report, commissioned by a judge and widely quoted in the media, claiming Moroccan border forces had actively aided about 70,000 people to cross the border in late July.
